integrated_description: Do not post the image and delete it immediately as a deliberate moral act, relinquishing any power held over the subject. Where others in the community are also aware of the image, intervene actively to discourage its spread; the threshold for excusing non-intervention is genuine impossibility or significant risk of harm to oneself, not mere personal discomfort or social awkwardness. This three-part commitment—non-posting, deletion, and substantive community intervention—reflects that ethical responsibility extends beyond private restraint to actively shaping healthier norms.
integration_rationale: Stakeholder B's modification was directly incorporated by replacing the permissive 'where possible' qualifier with an explicit, higher threshold for excusing inaction, ensuring the intervention obligation is substantive rather than easily waived. Stakeholders A and C accepted without modification, so the core three-part synthesis was preserved in full.
